title: SAML handshake simulator + assertion replay inspector for setup validation and admin audit
creator: Lena Park
description: Build an interactive SAML handshake simulator and assertion replay inspector that operators and delegated admins can use to validate IdP metadata ingestion and connector configuration without touching production traffic. The tool performs a dry-run metadata exchange, validates XML signatures and canonicalization, simulates AuthnRequests and Responses against configured SP endpoints, replays real assertion payloads in a sandbox, and emits structured audit entries that obey RBAC v2 masking and retention rules. Objectives: 1) reduce setup debugging time for SAML connectors, 2) prevent onboarding regressions by surfacing signature/cert issues and canonicalization mismatches, 3) provide auditable artifacts for compliance teams without exposing PII, and 4) integrate simulator actions into existing audit logs and the Console rollout UI.
tasks: Draft design doc and threat model -> Confluence (link in links)
Prototype metadata dry-run importer that validates certificates, entityID, and validUntil fields
Implement handshake simulator service: send synthetic AuthnRequest, capture SP redirect and ACS responses
Assertion replay sandbox: accept recorded assertion JSON, run through full validation stack without persisting PII
Integrate with RBAC v2: feature gating so only connector-admin or security-admin roles can run full replay
Emit structured audit events to audit-log pipeline with masking level determined by role and retention policy
Create Console UX: 'Simulate handshake' action, results panel, and link to generated diagnostic bundle
Add e2e tests and CI job, plus load test for simulator endpoint to ensure safe concurrency limits
Documentation & runbook: operator steps and rollback guidance
Security review and privacy sign-off prior to feature flag ramp
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can ingest IdP metadata and report a deterministic validation result (pass/fail + diagnostics)
Simulator performs an AuthnRequest/Response round-trip against a test SP endpoint and records detailed HTTP/SAML traces
Assertion replay executes schema and signature validation, and returns parsed attributes without PII in logs when run by non-privileged roles
All simulator actions generate structured audit events sent to the audit pipeline within 5s of completion
RBAC gates prevent replay/diagnostic bundle downloads for roles lacking connector-admin permission
Simulator accepts a dry-run import mode that produces a non-destructive metadata change preview and potential fix suggestions
End-to-end integration test exists that runs in CI nightly and validates canonicalization and signature handling across OpenSAML and current runtime
Design doc, Confluence runbook, and a customer-facing KB describing the new 'Simulate handshake' flow are published
